desc: The Bushnell Match Pro Rifle Scope is a purpose-built competition riflescope, and is the perfect choice for getting into PRS, NRL, or NRL22 competition. The 10-MIL turrets work on a simple base-10 system for speed & efficiency giving you a competitive edge on the firing line. Etched glass reticle is tough and ready to handle duty on your rifle. Locking turrets guarantee your dials stay right where you left them.
